asr.full_text: in the next five minutes I'll show you how you can earn Tron daily, pay directly and instantly to your own a Tron wallet, just like thousands of people around the world, introducing the world's first 100 percent decentralized crowd fund platform programmed on a Tron smart contract called Forsage where 100 percent of the income goes directly and transparently to the members of the platform with zero risk. Forsage's genius and lucrative crowdfund platform is programmed on the Tron blockchain with revolutionary smart contract technology that executes the program automatically in a decentralized way, so no admins are needed to run the platform. It's impossible for the platform creators, or anyone, to change the code and execution of the Smart Contract. This ensures that the Crowdfund platform will keep running and there is zero risk or possibility of hacking into the Smart Contract or stopping the project. Unlike centralized cryptocurrency projects, the founders of Forsage never take or store members' cryptocurrency in any centralized location so it's completely secure. 100% of all Tron payments are sent instantly and directly to members of Forsage and stored in their personal Tron wallets, which they control with private keys. You can easily verify all of the transactions on the Tron blockchain as the platform is fully transparent. Right now over 2,000 people are joining the Forsage crowdfund platform worldwide every single day. With Forsage's decentralized crowdfund platform,3, the X4 and X Gold. In the Forsage X3 program, there are three places in one line. In the Forsage X4 program, there are two lines. In the X Gold program, you have 30 places on four lines, two in the first line, four places in the second line, eight in the third and 16 in the first line, 4 places in the second line, 8 in the third, and 16 in the fourth. When you register with Forsage, the first slot of X3 and X4 programs costs 100 TRX each and X Gold 200 TRX. They are bought together separately, the first slots cannot be taken. You open all three programs simultaneously. All partners in your slots of the Forsage x3 program are your personally contributing partners. When you invite partners, they take places under you. The distribution of payments when filling out the slots automatically occurs as follows. The first contributing partner takes a place under you, 100% payout goes to your personal wallet, the second contributing partner takes second place below you, payment is also instantly credited to your personal wallet. The third partner takes 3rd place below you, you again receive 100% income but in the form of repeat, which opens the same slot for you again and you continue to receive income from it reopening the slot you take next free place in your superior partners slot accordingly 100 percent four repeats is transferred to your superior in the Forsage X4 program partners who take two places below you in the first line are two places in the 2nd line of the higher. A 100% payment goes to the wallet of your higher Partner. You also receive income from the second line, 100% from four people. Of these, three payments go instantly to your wallet The last payout is the closing slot and it also makes a repeat buying you the same slot again And the payment of 100% is transferred to your higher partner For members who take two places below you in the first line go to your up line Or they spill over to someone else on your team you receive 100 of the payments on the second line spots three four and five go to your wallet while spot six reopens the slots again with empty spots and payment goes to your upline for forsaaj x gold payments of two people in the first line go to your upline from for sage X gold payments of two people in the first line it go to your upline from the second line you get 20 percent from each of the four places from the third and line you get 30 percent and from the fourth line you get 50 percent from 16 places thus the total yield is 11120 percent from one circle of the matrix of which 100 percent is used for automatic repeat so last two payments from 4 line 50 plus 50 percent are used for repeat in each of these programs Versage X3 and Versage X4 have 15 slots that are all similar and work in the same way each subsequent slot is two times more expensive than the previous one both income and profits from them are twice as high. In Forsage X-Fold, the order of cost by slot is different. The first one costs 200 Trons, the second one costs 400. And then up to the 10th slot there is simply a doubling. And from the 10th, the most interesting levels begin revealing the possibilities of the Forsage Crowdfund platform. up to the 10th slot there is simply a doubling and from the tenth the most interesting levels begin revealing the possibilities of the Forage crowdfund platform how many slots can be activated immediately as much as you want they have no expiration date so you can't be afraid that they will burn all active slots move and bring you revenue in parallel there is a system in place that incentivizes members to upgrade to higher slots in the platform from the profits they already made.
